desc:
🎁 JOIN THE COMMUNITY SERVER FOR CODES AND UPDATES!

⚽Build the ultimate striker, one part at a time! ⚽

🎲 Roll a random team, from First Selection all the way up to Pros
🛡️Get a random player from that team
🧠 Choose ONE of their 10 attributes: Shooting, Speed, Dribbling, Passing, Physical, Defense, Vision, IQ, Ego or Weapon
🏆10 rounds. Climb the LEADERBOARD and prove you're the #1 Egoist!

👍 Like the game + favorite ⭐ to help support the game!

⚠️ DISCLAIMER: This fan-made, unofficial game was created by huge Blue Lock fans as a tribute to the anime and to share our passion with the community.
